metadata.technology_reasoning: Automatic capsule filling machines dominate pharmaceutical and nutraceutical industries for high-throughput production; they automate the dosing and filling of powders or granules into capsules, with a well-standardized design for efficiency and precision.

components.reasoning: This subsystem orients and feeds empty capsules into the filling machine, essential and always present as a separate, standardized unit.
The core functional module that measures and fills powders/granules into capsules, critical and universally present as a distinct assembly.
Ensures correct capsule halves alignment for filling, a standard part of all automatic machines to maintain filling quality.
Mechanism for joining capsule body and cap after filling, fundamental and procured as a separate assembly in most designs.
Central control electronics unit allowing programmable operation and monitoring, standard across modern capsule fillers.
Powers the moving components of the machine, essential mechanical subsystem with separate procurement.
Removes excess powder and dust to ensure capsule cleanliness; common but configuration varies by model.
Structural assembly housing all subcomponents, typically stainless steel for GMP compliance, a fundamental module.
